evidence: Measured existing integration run; this compact summary is extracted from the original reports, not a rerun or a replacement for the full audit.
contact_scope: Actual instance origins compared with the reconstructed triangle surface using BVH nearest distance; not a blade collision or full-scene physics check.
mask_scope: Actual instance centers projected through the calibrated CV camera into the source-resolution manual mask; blade geometry may extend beyond the region.
mask_pixel_mapping: world->CV->source K; floor pixel coordinates with centers at i+0.5
limitations: manual mask and declared world orientation
single-view 2.5D surface; unseen geometry is not reconstructed
image texture comes from reference, not a learned procedural material
no mechanism induction or global optimization in v0.2
Checks cover instance centers/origins, not complete grass blades, collision freedom or physical correctness.
The local overview exposes stretched single-view image textures; it is not an independent ground-truth view.
